sections.title: The Autumn Edit
sections.subtitle: A fashion editorial in wool, silk and low light

sections.html:
Ten looks, one long afternoon, and a north-facing window.

This is the full edit from our autumn shoot — the seams, the movement, and the quiet frames between the poses. Everything here was made with available light, in a single sitting, the way a magazine spread is built.

Mark the frames you love. Your shortlist becomes the final cut — and the studio behind this issue takes a small number of commissions each season.

sections.heading: Your Shortlist
sections.emptyHint: Tap the ♥ on a frame — the ones you keep gather here for the final cut.

sections.heading: Commission the next issue
sections.body: We shoot a small number of editorial commissions each season — campaigns, lookbooks and portfolios. Tell us what you're making and we'll bring the light.
